tier_should.rationale: Innovative, credible measures of biodiversity risk and firm exposures; clear validation via news, portfolios, and surveys; distinct from climate risk; public data release. Strong empirical contribution fits top finance journals; general-interest breadth moderate.

tier_will.rationale: Authored by leading researchers, timely topic, solid identification and multiple measures; clear asset-pricing tests and industry exposure patterns. Likely to land in JF/JFE/RFS; slim chance at top-five general.
